claim_boundary: Each entry names a file that still contains a construct the Effect boundary lint forbids, the rules it is exempt from, the lane that owns it and why. The list may only shrink; a stale entry fails the lint; a new entry needs a reason and a lane.

lanes.HISTORICAL_S2S: SWM-0W S2S historical lane: retained byte-stable for the ignored handoff tests and the sealed hosted-process receipts; not migrated before the G1 verdict (closure plan SR-4/SR-5).
lanes.DNRD5_PROTOCOL: DNRD-5 protocol source read by the source-closure judge (test/dnrd5-source-closure.test.ts) and pinned by the DNRD-4/DNRD-5 worktrees; converted only under a DNRD amendment, never silently.
lanes.TEMPORAL_SDK_LANE: Temporal workflow/worker/activities lane compiled under tsconfig.temporal.json; the workflow sandbox forbids Effect and non-deterministic imports and the selected TS G0 Temporal execution (75cc879) keeps this lane SDK-native.
lanes.GRAPH_STANDARDS_PINNED: Byte-bound by the graph-standards acceptance lock (hswm-graph-standards verify pins its digest); any edit invalidates the lock.
lanes.FOUNDATION_ADAPTER: The two Node adapters (POSIX filesystem, bounded subprocess): async/await and throw exist only inside Effect.tryPromise / Effect.async / acquireUseRelease callbacks that are mapped to typed errors at the same call site.
lanes.NEO4J_DRIVER_ADAPTER: neo4j-driver transaction functions are Promise-based and roll back only by throwing inside executeWrite/executeRead; every call is wrapped in Effect.tryPromise and mapped to a typed projection error at the call site.
